_doc: Medium batch m05 (Sonnet generic pass): crab family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults.

mud-crab-brawler/f:b1.note: mud bomb = fat mud drops with a dark pool; slash was meaningless

mud-crab-brawler/f:u1.note: mud crack from heavy blunt claws: thump blocks, not a slash

shore-crab/f:b0.note: snip is a claw cut; not on the bite keyword list but bite reads right

shore-crab/f:b1.note: shoreline spray = mist puffs, avoids duplicate slash

shore-crab/f:u3.note: clack = sharp claw click warning; trick with no tag/keyword

ghost-crab/f:u1.note: sand throw = sand cloud, avoids shock/zig on a non-electric crab

ghost-crab/f:u2.note: pale hide fades like a ghost shimmer; art beats thorns tag, no thorny shell

land-crab-march/f:b1.note: sea-bound surge = water rush, ripples instead of a slash

land-crab-march/f:u1.note: burrow cover = dust kicked over the hole; avoids third shield

tide-crab-squire/f:b1.note: tidewave splash = spray puffs, avoids ripple on the next piece

tide-crab-squire/f:u1.note: sidle pinch (trip): avoids a third bite, slash is the untagged default

palm-thief-crab/f:b3.note: thieving grab = sticky snare, avoids two ripples

palm-thief-crab/f:u0.note: palm husk fibre wall: leaf, avoids third shield

hermit-crab-hoarder/f:b1.note: shell swap splash: water splash, avoids two slashes

hermit-crab-hoarder/f:u1.note: hoard toss = lobbed junk, blunt thump

coconut-hermit/f:b1.note: milk drench = white milk drops with a pool

rock-crab-pincher/f:u2.note: tide pool cover = crevice grit puff, avoids two ripples
